title: Model provider presets (contracts/providers/presets.json)
description: From API 1.51 (contracts/README.md, Model sources: presets). Not a message: the presets Admin › Model providers fills its form from. Studio embeds the file (gen/providers/) and serves it (GET /v1/studio/admin/provider-presets, openapi ProviderPreset is this item); the web never reads the file. Order in the file is the order in the picker (grouped Local, then Remote). check.py also checks: ids unique, a remote base_url https and not a literal loopback or private address, a server base_url's host host.docker.internal, a loopback or a private literal, and each preset as a body passes ProviderPut; from API 1.53 (plan 28) each thinking rule's match compiles, its default is one of its levels, its levels are off + on or some of off, low, medium, high, and a budget_tokens stays below thinking_tokens of its level.

thinking_tokens.description: from API 1.53: the extra output allowance per thinking level, added to a call's max_tokens (a ceiling, not a charge); off adds none

id.description: the provider name it fills; a remote preset's key file is named the same

models.description: the default list, the first is the default; a local server ships none (Fetch fills them)

key_secret.description: remote: the key file's name (required); a server preset has none

thinking.description: from API 1.53 (plan 28): how a model's thinking is set. A list of rules, the first whose match fits a model id gives its levels; "models" (OpenRouter): the levels come from its /models answer (reasoning.supported_efforts, mandatory), each sent as reasoning {effort}, off as effort none. Absent: no thinking control

plugin.description: from API 1.61: a plugin's preset: only the providers Add as provider makes from that plugin use it (for its thinking rules); never offered in the form (GET /admin/provider-presets leaves it out, its Fetch and key save are 404)

vision.description: from API 1.65 (contracts/README.md, Assistant: media and vision): a regular expression on the model id (RE2 and JavaScript alike) for the models that see images (an image in the chat goes to them directly); absent: none does

note.description: one grey line under the picker

thinkingRule.description: match: a regular expression on the model id (RE2 and JavaScript alike: no lookaround or backreferences); levels: each level's body fragment; always: the model always thinks and offers no control (no levels); default: the level the provider uses when nothing is sent
